app.name: Granary
app.tagline: A desktop client compatible with Silo media servers.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Granary
onboarding.step1: Add your Silo server by its address (for example https://media.example.com).
onboarding.step2: Sign in and pick your profile.
onboarding.step3: Browse your libraries and play: video runs in the native player with HDR and refresh-rate matching for your monitor.
onboarding.privacy: Your password is never stored; Granary keeps only the server's session token in Windows Credential Manager.

addServer.title: Add a server
addServer.label: Server address
addServer.hint: The address you use for the Silo web app. Without a scheme, https:// is assumed.
addServer.known: This server is already saved; adding it again updates its address.
addServer.warnInsecure: This address uses plain http. Your password and everything you watch travel unencrypted. Use https if the server offers it.
addServer.warnUntested: Granary has not been tested with this server version. Most things should work; report anything that does not.
addServer.warnOrigin: The server reports that it was reached as {{origin}}. If that is unexpected, a proxy or redirect sits in between.

login.title: Sign in to {{server}}
login.passwordChange: This account has a temporary password. Change it in the Silo web app, then sign in here again.
login.revoked: Your session ended. Please sign in again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.themeHint: True black turns the background fully off on OLED screens.
settings.serversHint: Add, sign in to or remove servers.
settings.hwdecHint: Decode video on the GPU. Turn off only to troubleshoot.
settings.renderQualityHint: How much GPU work goes into scaling and HDR. Automatic is High on this PC. Applies from the next title.
settings.renderQualityHintIntegrated: How much GPU work goes into scaling and HDR. Automatic is Balanced on this integrated GPU: no debanding, slightly cheaper HDR peak detection. Applies from the next title.
settings.superResolutionHint: The GPU driver upscales SDR video that is smaller than the screen. Uses more power; needs hardware decoding.
settings.rtxHdrHint: Turns SDR video into HDR while Windows HDR is on.
settings.dolbyVisionHint: Use Dolby Vision metadata. Off plays the HDR10 base layer of profile 7 and 8 files; profile 5 always uses Dolby Vision.
settings.hdrModeHint: When Windows HDR is already on, video is shown in HDR without any switching. Changes are always restored after playback.
settings.refreshHint: Automatic keeps VRR or the current rate when it fits, otherwise picks an exact multiple near the current rate, else resamples smoothly. Always restored.
settings.monitorsHint: Overrides per monitor. Peak and black level come from Windows (DXGI) unless set here.
settings.monitorFacts: {{refresh}} Hz · peak {{peak}} nits · SDR white {{white}} nits · {{hdr}}
settings.vrrHint: Windows cannot report VRR; when set, the refresh rate is never switched on this monitor.
settings.normalizeDownmixHint: Keeps surround sound mixed down to stereo or headphones from clipping.
settings.passthroughHint: Send Dolby/DTS audio unchanged to an AV receiver.
settings.exclusiveHint: Takes over the audio device during playback (WASAPI exclusive).
settings.audioLiveHint: Audio and display settings apply immediately, also during playback.
settings.preferSdh: Prefer subtitles for the hard of hearing
settings.about: Granary is an independent desktop client, compatible with Silo media servers.
settings.posterTagsHint: Shows 4K, HDR and audio badges on poster cards.
settings.themeMusicHint: Plays a title's theme tune quietly on its page, when the server has one.
settings.themeMusicLoopHint: Starts the tune again when it ends, for as long as the page is open.
settings.seekPreviewsHint: Thumbnails while you hover the seek bar. Sources are tried in the order below; the first one that has previews for the file is used.
settings.previewSourceServerHint: Preview images the server generated for the file.
settings.previewSourceSeekrHint: Ready-made previews from seekr.tv for movies and episodes it knows, with your own API key. Sends the title’s TMDB/IMDb id and runtime to Seekr.
settings.previewSourceLocalHint: Granary reads frames from the file itself. Uses some extra bandwidth while you hover the seek bar.
settings.seekrKeyHint: Stored in Windows Credential Manager. Get one at seekr.tv.
settings.seekrKeyInvalid: Seekr did not accept this key.
settings.artworkCacheHint: Posters and backgrounds are kept on this PC for faster browsing and offline use. Never grows past {{limit}}; artwork of titles you are still watching is kept longest.
settings.stillWatchingHint: After this many episodes in a row started on their own, the next one waits for you.
settings.ambientLetterboxHint: While the controls show, the black bars of wide films take a soft glow of the picture. Uses the seek previews of the current scene.

player.subStyleHint: Saved for this computer on the server. Applies to plain text subtitles; styled (ASS) subtitles keep their own look.
player.findUnavailable: This server has no subtitle search or translation set up for you.
player.translateNeedsTrack: Turn on a subtitle track first; it is the one translated.

errors.invalid_url: That is not a valid server address.
errors.tls_not_yet_valid: The server's certificate is not valid yet. Check the date and time of this PC.
errors.tls_untrusted: The server's certificate is not trusted by Windows. If it uses your own certificate authority, install that authority in Windows first.
errors.tls_name_mismatch: The server's certificate does not match this address.
errors.tls_revoked: The server's certificate has been revoked.
errors.tls_error: A secure connection to the server could not be established.
errors.unreachable: The server could not be reached. Check the address and your network.
errors.timeout: The server did not answer in time.
errors.redirected: The server redirects to another address. Enter the final address instead.
errors.not_silo: No Silo server (API v2) answers at this address.
errors.unsupported_api: This server speaks an API version Granary does not support.
errors.account_required: The sign-in provider accepted you, but the server has no account for you. Ask an administrator.
errors.password_change_required: This account must change its password first. Use the Silo web app.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.client_upgrade_required: The server requires a newer Granary.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.unavailable: The server is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.signed_out: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
errors.unknown_server: This server is no longer saved.
errors.decode: The server sent a response Granary does not understand.
errors.credentials: Windows Credential Manager could not be used.
errors.invalid_request: Granary sent an invalid request. Please try again.
errors.playback_unsupported: This server does not offer the playback protocol Granary needs.
errors.player_unavailable: The video player could not be started ({{reason}}).
errors.player_error: The video player reported an error ({{reason}}).
errors.playback_session_ended: The server ended this playback session.
errors.installation_changed: The server was reconfigured; progress may not be saved for this playback.
errors.stream_failed: The stream could not be recovered.

about.title: About Granary
about.compatible: Granary is an independent desktop client compatible with Silo media servers. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Silo project.
about.sourceOffer: Granary is free software under the GNU Affero General Public License v3 or later. Its complete source code is available from the repository.
about.updatesHint: Opens the releases page in your browser. Granary never updates itself.
about.logsHint: Logs stay on this PC. Tokens, passwords and signed URLs are removed before they are written and again when shown or exported.
